entries.title: Spatially resolved human kidney multi-omics single cell atlas highlights the key role of fibrotic microenvironment in kidney disease progression.
entries.disease: diabetic and hypertensive kidney disease with controls
entries.linealinkr_fit: Excellent disease/control kidney benchmark with explicit cluster labels and multimodal context.

entries.title: Targeting Immune-Fibroblast Crosstalk in Myocardial Infarction and Cardiac Fibrosis I
entries.disease: acute myocardial infarction, ischemic cardiomyopathy, non-ischemic cardiomyopathy, donor controls
entries.linealinkr_fit: Excellent heart disease communication benchmark with explicit lineage labels and disease etiology.

entries.title: Multimodal gene expression and chromatin accessibility profiles at the single-cell level of synovial tissue from individuals with arthritis
entries.linealinkr_fit: Strong inflammatory tissue benchmark with ready cell-type and subtype labels; weaker for explicit case-control comparison because the downloaded all-cell h5ad does not expose per-cell disease labels.

entries.title: Single Nuclei RNA-Seq to map progression of non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) in patients II
entries.disease: NAFLD, NASH, NASH with cirrhosis, end-stage disease, healthy controls
entries.linealinkr_fit: High-value liver disease progression benchmark with explicit disease spectrum and all-cell processed object.

entries.title: Deconvoluting clonal and cellular architecture in IDH-mutant Acute Myeloid Leukemia
entries.disease: IDH-mutant acute myeloid leukemia with longitudinal treatment states and donor controls
entries.linealinkr_fit: High-value hematologic malignancy benchmark with longitudinal structure, but large integrated objects.

entries.title: A single-cell RNA-seq dataset of synovial fluid from rheumatoid arthritis treated with TNF-α/JAK inhibitor
entries.disease: rheumatoid arthritis pre/post tofacitinib or adalimumab
entries.linealinkr_fit: High-value therapy-response autoimmune benchmark with a processed R object, though raw human sequence data are controlled access elsewhere.

entries.title: Single cell immune landscape of human atherosclerosis reveals the transcriptional signature of PLIN2hi/TREM1hi inflammatory lipid-associated macrophages and its association with cerebrovascular complications.
entries.linealinkr_fit: Biology is relevant, but the downloaded h5ad currently exposes patient IDs only and lacks ready cell-type labels.

entries.title: Resolving the fibrotic niche of human liver cirrhosis using single-cell transcriptomics
entries.disease: human liver cirrhosis with healthy liver and PBMC comparators
entries.tissue: human liver and blood; plus mouse liver fibrosis comparator
entries.linealinkr_fit: Biologically strong for fibrosis, but GEO supplementary layout currently shows raw matrices only with no obvious integrated annotation object.

entries.title: A single-cell transcriptomic atlas characterizes the kidney in the diabetic kidney disease
entries.disease: diabetic kidney disease with normal controls
entries.linealinkr_fit: Disease/control kidney dataset is relevant, but supplementary files currently appear to be raw sample tarballs without a ready annotated object.

entries.title: Dynamic changes of immune cells in systemic lupus erythematosus with nephritis using longitudinal peripheral blood single-cell RNA-seq
entries.disease: systemic lupus erythematosus with nephritis and healthy donors
entries.linealinkr_fit: Useful longitudinal autoimmune immune-only dataset, but GEO supplementary view does not expose a ready integrated cell-annotation object.
